content:
Any good/fast alternatives to carnation instant breakfast?
I seem to be okay with lactose in small quantities. I mix 8oz of lactose-free milk with 6 tablespoons of instant breakfast. It doesn't seem like it's a problem so far, but I was wondering if there were better alternatives? I don't have much of an appetite in the morning. I've lost 7lb over the last month due to IBS issues. Nothing dangerous, but I worked hard to gain those pounds and I want them back :(

My diet consists of this for breakfast, and rice-green beans-chicken thighs for dinner. I need more food! It's been so difficult to navigate this new diet.
